children: U.S. natural gas futures are lower as the Nymex January contract debuts at the front of the curve with the market anticipating a relatively mild winter. Storage data on Wednesday showed the first withdrawal of the season, with inventories standing 80 Bcf above the five-year average. "Inventories remain in healthy territory relative to historical benchmarks, leaving the market well positioned heading into the peak heating season," Andy Huenefeld of Pinebrook Energy Advisors said in a note. Natural gas for January delivery is down 4.7% at $3.485/mmBtu. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
